research_question: Can a reusable event-stitched projective mechanism atlas, with a shared low-dimensional health coordinate inferred from five output probes, outperform strong local and generic hybrid controls on independent battery cells while preserving an exact probe-certified fallback?
claim_boundary: A pass supports a reusable hybrid discharge/relaxation mechanism atlas and a probe-inferred chart coordinate across NASA battery cells. It does not establish online remaining-life prediction, causal identifiability under arbitrary current policies, universality across battery chemistries, or a general AI breakthrough.

source.name: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence Battery Data Set, BatteryAgingARC-FY08Q4

access_policy.holdout_access_condition: development_pass must be true and the candidate-lock SHA-256 must verify

inputs.hybrid_coordinate: z=q/q_off for samples through the final abs(I)>threshold event; z=1+(t-t_off)/(t_end-t_off) afterward
inputs.offline_conditioning_note: The complete measured time/current trajectory is treated as an observed intervention input. This is an offline response-identification test, not an online prognosis test.

atlas.projective_quotient: subtract endpoint chord, remove residual mean, divide by RMS norm, sign-align
atlas.tangent_mechanism: first SVD right singular vector after removing the base mechanism, orthogonalized and RMS normalized
atlas.tangent_orientation: orient training scores to increase with discharge order
atlas.candidate: for each output y=a+b*(z/2)+c*(h0(z)+eta*h1(z)); eta is shared across voltage and temperature

controls.strong_local: for each output independently choose pchip or cubic ridge polynomial in normalized time, cumulative charge, sample rank, or hybrid coordinate by leave-one-probe-out error; refit on all five probes
controls.generic_hybrid_cubic: degree-3 ridge polynomial in the same hybrid coordinate, fitted independently to each output using the same five probes
controls.no_event_ablation: development-only diagnostic using the same projective atlas construction on normalized cumulative charge without a relaxation chart

scoring.primary: RMS joint error on every non-probe raw sample using fixed physical scales
scoring.tail: same metric strictly after the final probe
scoring.relaxation: same metric strictly after the detected current-off event
scoring.catastrophic: nonfinite safe error or safe error greater than max(0.50, 4*local error)
